question: What is the name of badge that the user whose display name is "Pierre" obtained?
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching badges record.
gold: SELECT T2.Name FROM users AS T1 LEFT JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Pierre'
gold0: SELECT T2.Name FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Pierre'

c.request:
What is the name of badge that the user whose display name is "Pierre" obtained?
Also keep rows that have no matching badges record.
c.sql: SELECT b.Name FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Pierre';

b.request: List the names of badges earned by users whose display name is "Pierre", including those users even if they have no matching badge record
b.sql: SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName, b.Name AS BadgeName FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Pierre'

d.request: What is the name of the badge obtained by the user whose display name is “Pierre”? Include the user’s row even if there is no matching badge record.
d.sql: SELECT b.Name AS BadgeName FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Pierre';
